title: Introduction to Genetics and Genes
objectives: Define key genetic terminology (gene, allele, genome, etc.)
Describe the central dogma of molecular biology
Explain the significance of genetics in medicine

basic_concepts.title: Fundamental Concepts
basic_concepts.content:
• Gene: Basic unit of heredity (DNA sequence)
  • Allele: Variant form of a gene
  • Genome: Complete set of genetic material
  • Central Dogma: DNA → RNA → Protein

genotype_phenotype.title: Genotype vs Phenotype
genotype_phenotype.content:
Genotype
• Genetic constitution (e.g., BB, Bb, bb)
• Inherited from parents
Phenotype
• Observable characteristics
• Result of genotype + environment

medical_importance.title: Medical Applications
medical_importance.content:
Genetic Testing

Examples: Carrier screening, pharmacogenomics

Impact: Personalized medicine approaches

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.content:
Why can't phenotypes always predict genotypes?

Due to factors like incomplete penetrance, variable expressivity, and environmental influences (e.g., nutrition affecting height).
